cues.s: Ondo and BlackRock signed an MOU? Not quite.
On September 24th, Ondo launched three portfolio tokens built on BlackRock strategies.
One token holds a whole basket of stock, bond and bitcoin ETFs. Mint or redeem around the clock.
BlackRock only supplies the model. Ondo issues, tokenizes and runs everything.
And it's for non-US investors only.
Still, ONDO jumped about 18% in a day.
Verdict: a product deal, not an MOU. Not investment advice.
